title: AlphaFold3 predicts GLI-SUFU complex interfaces and identifies binding-defective variants
summary: AlphaFold3 and complementary computational analysis predicted structures of the three human GLI-SUFU complexes and the Drosophila Ci-Sufu complex, revealing previously unrecognized contact interfaces. Site-directed mutagenesis and GLI-SUFU binding assays validated key interface residues, many mutated in familial medulloblastoma and Gorlin syndrome. The authors offer this as a framework for interpreting SUFU missense variants of unknown significance. Preprint.
ai_technology: AlphaFold3 structure prediction of protein complexes

evidence.tested: Site-directed mutagenesis and GLI-SUFU binding assays on predicted interface residues.
evidence.unknown: Clinical interpretation of individual variants; full text not reviewed.
